title: Dateline Energy: Moving Forward Confidently in Nigeria
author: CFI.co Editorial
content_html: The CFI judging panel congratulates Dateline Energy Services on its recent restructuring and the creation of new platforms to ensure competitiveness in a tough market place. Dateline has a good record of working for a major international player having created a scope of work that is resulting in significant new business. This company is well placed to achieve significantly improved results for its stakeholders. Dateline wins our award for ‘Best Oil & Gas Project Support Services, Nigeria, 2013.’
